name: danielgtaylor-jpeg-archive
instr:
# Update danielgtaylor/jpeg-archive

The repository is in `/app/repo`. Update the existing C implementation to match the required behavior.

The authoritative documentation is in `/app/docs`. Documentation in the repository may be outdated.

Query `/opt/task-reference/executable` to observe the required behavior. It is execute-only. Do not copy, wrap, or invoke it from your submitted implementation.

Modify the existing repository. Do not replace it with an implementation in another language.

Run `/opt/task/build.sh` to build `/app/executable`. Only `/app/repo` is submitted: the verifier copies it into a separate clean container and rebuilds it offline using the same fixed command. Changes to that command and a prebuilt `/app/executable` are not used for grading. Required dependencies are preloaded. Network access is unavailable. Do not use external source code.

Hidden behavioral tests compare stdout, stderr, exit status, and applicable output files to the reference implementation. Some tests cover required changes, while others ensure existing behavior remains unchanged. Every hidden test must pass. Preserve unchanged behavior while implementing the required changes.

SmallFry scope: the grader does not evaluate SmallFry's numerical BBCQ calculation on fresh images. You do not need to reproduce that external algorithm or its empirical constants. The graded `jpeg-recompress` case only requires `-m smallfry` to be recognized as a valid method when an already processed input
